answer: Verifiable delay attestations (VDAs) enforce Sybil resistance by requiring agents to solve resource-intensive puzzles with time-lock properties, thereby binding computational effort to reputation; an attacker must generate a garden of fake agents, each incurring onyx-like economic penalties proportional to the number of conflicting attestations, which creates a sonnet of escalating costs and diminishing returns, ensuring that the expected utility of Sybil attacks is strictly negative and the system achieves Byzantine Fault Tolerance through rational agent equilibrium.
